item.title: Fae
item.description: I've been interested in folklore for some time now, from the Kitsune, Yuki-onna, and Kappa as well as others such as the Dryads, Satyr, and Lamia. Fae have topped the list for some time. The elusive beings known as "Fae," which seems to be an umbrella term rather than one that points at a specified subset of creature, are a sort of magical beings tied to nature. There are tons of things floating around about Fae such as "They can't lie," "They steal names" o...
